author: More Perfect Union
description:
Online banking isn't as safe as you think.

Silicon Valley-funded neobanks like PayPal, Venmo and Wealthfront offer lower fees and higher interest rates than big banks – and claim the same protections.

But thanks to Peter Thiel, Elon Musk, and other tech oligarchs, they operate in a legal gray area that makes your money less safe.

Producer: saninamillion
Editor: kungaaaaaaaa
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: The Billionaire Oligarchs Putting Your Venmo Funds At Risk
